answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of salvaged repair work: each identity must restore one broken public device, a ferrous sensor or dockside beacon, and log the repair at the wharf where strangers verify it works. The repaired relic stays in public use and is checked again next epoch. A farm must buy, fix, and maintain thousands of distinct devices, paying parts and hands-on time per fake, while one honest agent repairs the single device it already tends, once.
